description: This Java source file defines the TaxComponent class, representing a tax component entity with properties such as name, percentage, associated accounts, start date, and related histories and mappings. It includes methods for creation, updating, and retrieving applicable tax percentages.

classes.name: TaxComponent
classes.description: Entity class representing a tax component with properties such as name, percentage, account types, start date, and related histories and mappings. Provides methods for creation, updating, and retrieving applicable percentages.

methods.name: createTaxComponent
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new TaxComponent with specified properties.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the TaxComponent's properties based on a JsonCommand, tracking changes and creating history records for percentage updates.

methods.name: updateStartDate
methods.description: Helper method to update the start date of the TaxComponent based on command input or current date.

methods.name: getPercentage
methods.description: Returns the current percentage of the tax component.

methods.name: startDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the tax component.

methods.name: getApplicablePercentage
methods.description: Calculates and returns the applicable percentage for a given date, considering historical changes.

methods.name: occursOnDayFrom
methods.description: Checks if a given date is after the start date, indicating applicability.

methods.name: getTaxComponentHistories
methods.description: Returns the set of historical percentage changes.

methods.name: getTaxGroupMappings
methods.description: Returns the set of tax group mappings.

methods.name: allStartDates
methods.description: Returns a collection of all start dates associated with the tax component and its histories.

methods.name: getDebitAccountType
methods.description: Returns the debit account type identifier.

methods.name: getCreditAccountType
methods.description: Returns the credit account type identifier.
